stories.title: Spain transport minister says he will not resign after high‑speed rail collision
stories.summary: Spain’s transport minister Óscar Puente told a news conference in Madrid that he will not resign following the high‑speed rail collision that has killed at least 69 people. He said he has “nothing to hide” and emphasized the government’s commitment to investigate the disaster fully. Puente added that his priority is to resolve the problem rather than discuss his position.
stories.why: The statement signals continuity in leadership while the investigation proceeds, affecting public confidence and the rail safety response.

stories.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
stories.summary: Hundreds of residents of the devastated Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have been evacuated, Russian and Ukrainian authorities have said, following a humanitarian ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump. Ukrainian authorities confirmed the evacuees were on their way to southern Russia, from where they will travel on to Ukraine through Belarus.
